chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Safwan ibn Yahya from Najiyah ibn al-Harith said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about the birds of the water and what the fish eats from it, is it permissible? He said, 'There is no harm with it, eat it all.'

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: There is no harm with it (permissible)

ai.seo_question: Are aquatic birds and the fish that eat them permissible to consume according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him), transmitted via the reliable chain of al-Tusi in *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, establishes the permissibility of aquatic birds and their prey as halal food sources. It reflects the Shia juristic principle that aquatic creatures are generally permissible unless explicitly prohibited, reinforcing the ease (*rukhas*) in dietary laws for believers.
